termsBody: Allingo provides test-prep tools and an AI tutor for personal study. Practice tests are written by Allingo and are not official ETS, Cambridge, JF/JEES or Hanban exams.
You are responsible for keeping your account secure and must not share paid accounts.
Results and estimated scores are for reference only and do not replace official certificates.
AI-generated content may contain mistakes; verify with a teacher when needed.
Paid plans, refunds and AI credits follow the pricing policy published at the time of purchase.
privacyBody: We collect your email/phone, study progress, answers and recordings (when you consent to voice processing) to provide the service.
Essays and recordings are stored in a private bucket, accessed only via short-lived signed URLs, and deleted after 90 days (Free) or 365 days (Pro).
Content sent to AI models never includes your name, email or phone number.
You can request account deletion in Settings; deletion completes within 72 hours, and billing records are retained in anonymized form as required by law.
We comply with Vietnam's Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection.
